SRSCAN_CRIB_TREX_RGB

 [Next Routine] [List of Routines] 
srscan_crib_trex_rgb.pro
usage:
 .run srscan_crib_trex_rgb

Purpose: demonstrate loading and displaying data from the TREx RGB
 (Transition Region Explorer) full-colour all-sky imager array.

 TREx RGB data is loaded from the UCalgary Space Remote Sensing (SRS)
 Open Science Platform, located at https://data.phys.ucalgary.ca.

 Datatypes:
   'raw'     stream0 color raw images (byte [n,3,553,480], 3s cadence)
   'keogram' archived hourly keograms (lossy JPEG quicklooks, intensity pre-scaled)
   'grid'    pre-rendered mosaic grids (selected intervals only)

 Routing downloads through an HTTP proxy is supported. To use this, set
 the standard SPEDAS http_proxy environment variable before loading, e.g.
   setenv, 'http_proxy=http://proxy.example.org:3128'

Written by: Darren Chaddock, 2026-08-18

(See projects/srs_canada/examples/srscan_crib_trex_rgb.pro)

SRSCAN_CRIB_TREX_RGB_MOSAIC

 [Previous Routine] [List of Routines] 
srscan_crib_trex_rgb_mosaic.pro
usage:
 .run srscan_crib_trex_rgb_mosaic

Purpose: demonstrate TREx RGB mosaics.

 srscan_trex_rgb_mosaic projects each camera's frame onto a geographic
 map through its skymap (110 km assumed emission height) and paints in
 24-bit decomposed colour. Where fields of view overlap, the camera viewing
 that patch of sky at the higher elevation angle (closer to its zenith,
 i.e. less obliquely) wins. Therefore, near-horizon views are stretched
 and smeared, so the least-distorted view paints on top.

 The MOSv001 grid product is the verified archive mosaic rendering of the
 same data. More information can be found in the TREx RGB dataset description
 at https://data.phys.ucalgary.ca.

Written by: Darren Chaddock, 2026-08-18

(See projects/srs_canada/examples/srscan_crib_trex_rgb_mosaic.pro)
